title: Welcome to the world, 2000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Baby shower and baby Christening gift Beautiful moments eternalized in precious metals Touching gesture Sentimental value that will never fade The reverse of the coin features the imprint of a baby’s tiny feet. Along the edge, there are 120 hearts, representing the number of heartbeats per minute of a child after birth, and 270 dashes symbolizing the number of days (9 months) from conception to birth. It’s the perfect present for your child, grandchild, nephew, or a friend who recently celebrated a new arrival!
